title: Mara gaya darya pe
body:
Maara gaya darya pe jo shehdaye sakina..(2)
Shae rag se sadaa aati rahi haaye sakina
<<MINI>>
Haaye sakina, haaye sakina..
Haaye sakina, haaye sakina..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Sheh se kaha abbas ne darr hai mujhe aaqa..(3)
darya pe kahi'n roti na aa jaye sakina
<<MINI>>
Haaye sakina, haaye sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Laashe se sadaa aati thi hum bhi na piyenge..(3)
jab tak tumhe paani nahi mil jaye sakina
<<MINI>>
Haaye sakina, haaye sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kis tarha se dikhlau tumhe shakl dobara..(3)
jab paani hi mashkize se beh jaye sakina
<<MINI>>
Haaye sakina, haaye sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Majboor hai bazu bhi nahi tum hi batao..(3)
kis tarha se ammu tumhe behlaye sakina
<<MINI>>
Haaye sakina, haaye sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Zainab ne kaha zere alam peet ke sar ko..(3)
matam karo maara gaya saqqa e sakina
<<MINI>>
Haaye sakina, haaye sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aajaiye yu zauja e abbas pukari..(3)
waali kahi'n furqat mein na mar jaye sakina
<<MINI>>
Haaye sakina, haaye sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Sab chahne wale to anees hogaye maqtool..(3)
rukhsar ke neel ab kise dikh laye sakina
<<MINI>>
Haaye sakina, haaye sakina..(2)
